The '''LPL 2019 Spring''' split was organized by TJ Sports and held from January 14 to April 21 across seven home-and-away venues throughout China. The season adopted a full league structure<ref name="2019 spring schedule">{{cite web|url=https://www.weibo.com/5720474518/HafAHwUJW?refer_flag=1001030103_&type=comment#_rnd1546509364794|title=【LPL春季赛赛程公布 1月7日开启售票】|date=2019-01-03|author=英雄联盟|publisher=Weibo}}</ref>, removing the previous group system in favor of a Single Round Robin involving 16 teams. Playoffs followed a single-elimination bracket culminating in the finals at the Foshan International Sports Performing Arts Center. The tournament was played on patches 9.1 to 9.6.

The split awarded championship points and determined the region’s representative for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|Mid-Season Invitational 2019]], while also contributing to seeding for [[Rift Rivals/LCK-LPL-LMS-VCS/2019|Rift Rivals 2019]]. SinoDragon Club joined the league after their application was approved, and Victory Five entered the league.

===Playoffs===
{{ShowBracket|id=F2GTWLKM3K}}


==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''January 14th - March 31st, 2019''
** Single round robin, {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th till 8th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''9th till 16th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''April 4th - April 21st, 2019''
** Single Elimination, {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Top 4 qualifies for [[Rift Rivals/2019/LCK-LMS-LPL|Rift Rivals 2019 - LCK vs LMS vs LPL]]
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|Mid-Season Invitational 2019]]
